target.title: Detect Ollama WorkOS sign-in redirects
target.body:
## Summary
- detect Ollama `/signin` redirects before attempting usage parsing
- recognize the WorkOS AuthKit authorization destination on any `*.workos.com` host carrying the `/user_management/authorize` path
- surface expired-session recovery instead of a misleading parser failure

## Live runtime proof

A live probe linked against `CodexBarCore` drove the real `OllamaUsageFetcher` against `https://ollama.com/settings` with a synthetic (invalid) session cookie and a redirect logger. No real account or secret was used; the captured chain is the real unauthenticated Ollama/WorkOS sign-in flow:

```text
$ swift test --disable-sandbox --filter LiveOllamaWorkOSProbe
isSignInRedirect(api.workos.com/user_management/authorize) = true
isSignInRedirect(ollama.com/signin) = true
[ollama] Redirect 303 https://ollama.com/settings -> https://ollama.com/signin
[ollama] Redirect 303 https://ollama.com/signin -> https://api.workos.com/user_management/authorize?client_id=...&provider=authkit&redirect_uri=...&response_type=code
[ollama] Redirect 302 https://api.workos.com/user_management/authorize?... -> https://signin.ollama.com/?client_id=...&authorization_session_id=...
[ollama] Response: 200 https://signin.ollama.com/?client_id=...
[ollama] Parse failed: Could not parse Ollama usage: Missing Ollama usage data.
RESULT: fetch threw -> parseFailed("Missing Ollama usage data.")
✔ Test run with 1 test in 1 suite passed after 1.793 seconds.
```

The matcher classifies the **real captured** `api.workos.com/user_management/authorize` URL as a sign-in redirect (`true`), so an expired session that lands on a WorkOS authorize page throws `invalidCredentials` and CodexBar tries the next cookie candidate instead of falling through to a parse failure.

## Note for the maintainer (honest limitation)

The live unauthenticated chain ultimately lands on `signin.ollama.com` (HTTP 200), not on a WorkOS host, so for the *unauthenticated* path the redirect matcher does not fire and the fetch falls through to `Missing Ollama usage data`. The WorkOS authorize URL appears as an *intermediate* 303/302 hop (verified live above), and `isSignInRedirect` returns `true` for that real URL. The matcher's value is the expired-session case where the final redirect lands on the WorkOS authorize page (200 HTML) rather than continuing to `signin.ollama.com` — that terminal-WorkOS-landing shape is covered deterministically by the injected-transport test suite (19 tests, including the `auth.workos.com` and `api.workos.com` positive cases and an `example.com` negative case). The broadened `*.workos.com` host match survives WorkOS host changes/CNAMEs; the previous `host == "api.workos.com"` exact match would miss `auth.workos.com`.

## Testing
- `swift test --disable-sandbox --filter OllamaUsageFetcherTests` (19 passed)
- live probe above against the real `ollama.com` / WorkOS sign-in flow (1.79s)
- `swift build` clean
target.author: joevenner
